notablePrerequisites: Shadowheart does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Activate Shadowheart by paying {1}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing the Fractal, causing you to draw your library.
